title: Cochinita Pibil
description: A traditional Mexican dish from the Yucatán region, Cochinita Pibil is a slow-roasted pork marinated in citrus juice, spices, and chili peppers.
instructions: In a blender, combine orange and lime juice, chilies, garlic, cumin, and oregano. Blend until smooth.
Rub the marinade all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Cover the pork and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Place the pork in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, fat side up.
Roast the pork for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 190°F (88°C).
Let the pork rest for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the pork with your choice of sides, such as rice, beans, or tortillas.
